name: bubble
title: Bubble
description: Displays conversational content with variants, grouping, reactions, and polymorphic surfaces.
docs: ## Installation ```install npx shadcn@latest add @cadence/bubble ``` ## Usage ```tsx import { Bubble, BubbleContent, BubbleGroup, BubbleReactions } from "@/components/cadence/bubble"; export function Conversation() { return ( Ready for review? The registry is ready. 👍 ); } ``` ## Variants and alignment Choose default, secondary, muted, tinted, outline, ghost or destructive. Bubbles cap at 80% of their container; ghost can use its full width. Start is the default alignment; end aligns a bubble to the opposite inline edge. Include readable error context for destructive content so color is not the only signal. Destructive uses a tinted background and destructive border with foreground text to retain readable contrast in both themes. ```tsx Message failed. Try again from the message actions. ``` ## Consecutive messages BubbleGroup groups surfaces from the same sender. It supplies a small gap; leave more vertical space when reactions overlap. Set alignment on each Bubble. Names, avatars, timestamps and conversation semantics belong to your surrounding UI. ```tsx First thought. One more detail. ``` ## Links and buttons BubbleContent accepts a Base UI render element or function. Use a real button with an explicit type or an anchor with href; their text provides the accessible name. Native handlers and refs, including React 19 ref cleanup, are merged by Base UI. ```tsx }>View attachments ``` ## Reactions Side defaults to bottom and align to end. Both accept the opposite edge. The row uses static positioning transforms, never animated movement. Label emoji-only rows as a single image; for interactive reactions supply named buttons and their pressed state instead. Leave vertical space for the overlapping row. ```tsx 👍🔥 ``` ## Updating text Keep the message ID and rendered element stable when adding text. Children update immediately without replaying entry, moving focus or animating measured height. The application owns chunking, message IDs, transport, cancellation, retry and scroll anchoring. This component neither parses Markdown nor orchestrates a stream. ## When to use Use for conversational text, quoted replies, suggestion buttons and short structured output; combine surfaces into a caller-owned conversation layout. ## When not to use Use Attachment for file metadata, Code Block for syntax-highlighted source, and Alert for a page-level notice. Bubble supplies a surface rather than a complete chat, message scroller, composer or streaming runtime. ## API | Part | Props and defaults | | --- | --- | | `Bubble` | Native div props; variant default/secondary/muted/tinted/outline/ghost/destructive (default: default), align start/end (default: start) | | `BubbleGroup` | Native div props; groups consecutive bubbles | | `BubbleContent` | Base UI useRender div props; render element or function | | `BubbleReactions` | Native div props; side top/bottom (default: bottom), align start/end (default: end) | All four parts retain upstream bubble-* slots (root: bubble), native styles, refs and events. Classes merge last; Bubble styles merge after its local clock. Bubble exposes data-variant, data-align and data-motion; reactions expose data-side and data-align. No additional message-state or validation API is introduced. ## Motion contract | Cause | Recipe | Full | Reduced | None | | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | | New Bubble enters | `data.transition` | Opacity 0→1, duration.base / ease.out | Opacity only, duration ×0.6 | Opacity 1 on first frame, zero duration | CSS @starting-style performs a one-shot entry. The duration resolves locally through cm.transition("data.transition"), including provider timeScale, so an inner full scope restores its clock inside outer none. Reduced drops animated transforms; this recipe uses opacity in full too. Live none cancels entry on the same node. Existing text, variants, alignment, reactions and resize update immediately. Removal is immediate; there is no exit or layout animation. Caller-provided motion is caller-owned. ## Keyboard interactions Presentational surfaces add no tab stops. Tab reaches rendered buttons, links and reaction buttons. Enter activates buttons/links; Space activates buttons. Interactive BubbleContent has a visible focus ring. Appending text preserves the same focused node. The application owns focus after removing a message. ## Accessibility Keep conversation-level semantics on a surrounding labelled region. Supply readable sender/error context and label reactions. Avoid nested interactive content inside button/link bubbles. Announce meaningful completed updates in a separate polite status region when needed; announcing every chunk can overwhelm assistive technology. ## Responsiveness and performance Long words wrap within a shrinking container. Reactions overlap vertically; give rows sufficient space and keep reaction collections compact. Rich content can use ghost with its own overflow treatment. Entry changes only opacity; no layout reads, per-frame JavaScript, timers or forced remounts. Application pagination or virtualization owns very large histories. No @shadcn/react dependency is needed for this pinned API. ## AI usage notes Compose the four parts with stable message IDs. Text and reaction state remain in your application. Use Collapsible for optional show-more UI and Tooltip/Popover for metadata; those components keep their own motion contracts. Do not invent streaming, validation or networking props on Bubble. ## Related components [Attachment](/components/attachment), [Code Block](/components/code-block), [Collapsible](/components/collapsible), [Tooltip](/components/tooltip), [Popover](/components/popover).
